title: Agarwal Residence
subtitle: Complete Home Interior – Living, Dining, Kitchen, Bedrooms & Bathrooms
description: A 2,500 sq.ft. complete home interior in Balurghat, designed as one continuous open-plan living, dining and kitchen space in soft sage and light oak, with a brass lattice feature wall, glass-block partitions, a calm master suite, a playful kids' room and two distinctly styled bathrooms.
body:
Designed for the Shubham Agarwal family in Balurghat, this 2,500 sq.ft. residence was planned as a complete home interior, from the living room and kitchen to the bedrooms, bathrooms and balcony. The aim was a home that feels calm, bright and connected, with each room given its own character within a single design language.

Living, dining and kitchen form one continuous open plan, unified by soft sage, light oak and continuous cove lighting. A backlit brass lattice wall gives the living room its focal point, an aqua glass-block partition shares light between zones, and a high-gloss sage U-shaped kitchen with a breakfast counter keeps everyday cooking and family time together.

The private spaces shift in mood. The master suite is serene, with a marble-finish headboard wall and fluted wardrobes. The kids' room becomes a playful sky of balloons, clouds and a glowing moon, with a built-in study. The two bathrooms take different directions, one bold in green tile and gold, the other calm and minimal, while the balcony extends the home outdoors with a warm wood-slat ceiling and wicker seating.
features.0.title: A Brass Lattice Living Room
features.0.text: The sofa wall is anchored by a backlit brass geometric lattice panel with a sunburst centrepiece, framed in light oak panelling with brass globe sconces. Opposite, a marble-finish TV wall sits between sage fluted panels and open bookshelves, while an aqua glass-block partition brings light and colour into the space.
features.1.title: One Continuous Open Plan
features.1.text: Living, dining and kitchen are planned as a single, uninterrupted run. Continuous cove lighting, a consistent sage-and-oak palette and the glass-block partition tie the zones together, so the home reads as one generous, connected space.
features.2.title: Dining & Wash Area
features.2.text: A solid wood dining table with boucle chairs sits beside the kitchen counter, under Roman blinds framed in oak. A floating wash basin is set against a backlit feature wall with sculpted stone forms, beside the glass-block partition.
features.3.title: A Sage U-Shaped Kitchen
features.3.text: High-gloss sage cabinetry wraps a U-shaped kitchen with a breakfast counter and bar stools. Black-framed glass shutters, a floor-to-ceiling lit crockery unit and pendant lights over the counter add definition without breaking the soft palette.
features.4.title: A Calm Master Suite
features.4.text: The master bedroom pairs an upholstered panel headboard with a veined marble-finish wall and slim brass inlays, flanked by globe wall lights. Full-height wardrobes with sage fluted inserts and long brass handles keep the room serene and uncluttered.
features.5.title: A Kids' Room Above the Clouds
features.5.text: Hot-air balloon wallpaper, an arched fluted headboard, backlit cloud cut-outs and a glowing moon panel turn the kids' room into a soft, playful sky. A built-in study desk with lit shelving and a wardrobe with a playful graphic shutter make it practical for growing children.
features.6.title: Two Bathrooms, Two Moods
features.6.text: One bathroom pairs green picket-tile shower walls with terrazzo, a fluted glass partition and brushed gold fittings. The other is calm and minimal, with fluted wall cladding, a sculpted pentagon mirror, a vessel basin and a warm wood-slat ceiling.
highlights.0.title: Brass Lattice Feature Wall
highlights.0.text: A backlit geometric brass panel with sunburst centrepiece anchors the living room.
highlights.1.title: Glass-Block Partition
highlights.1.text: An aqua glass-block wall separates zones while sharing light across the open plan.
highlights.2.title: Unified Sage & Oak Palette
highlights.2.text: The same sage and light oak run through living, kitchen, bedrooms and joinery.
highlights.3.title: Continuous Cove Lighting
highlights.3.text: Perimeter cove lines and recessed downlights stitch the open-plan zones together.
highlights.4.title: Themed Kids' Room
highlights.4.text: Balloon wallpaper, backlit clouds and a moon panel with a built-in study unit.
highlights.5.title: Every Room Designed
highlights.5.text: Living, dining, kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and the balcony in one scheme.
